The plot script generates generic reproduction plots and does not correspond to any PDF object; no repository visual source is recorded and no repository was cloned.

paper_style.palette_strategy: No Figure/Table palette exists. Rendered pages use black text and equations with purple citation/link text; these colors do not encode data series, categories, uncertainty, or results.
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: pdfimages -list reports no embedded raster image XObjects and the PDF has no /Subtype /Image; text, equations, rules, and theorem blocks are vector PDF objects. There is therefore no Figure/Table vector–raster mix.
paper_style.style_consistency: The single-column letter layout and heading, theorem, equation-number, footnote, and appendix-proof hierarchy are consistent across all 21 pages. Figure/Table-specific typography, captions, headers, color, or geometry cannot be compared because both object classes are absent.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: There is no Figure/Table narrative. The paper's evidence path is carried by prose and numbered mathematics: Example 2 and counter intuition lead to the tiling/gadget reduction, precision bound, UHAT-to-LTL construction, succinctness results, and completeness theorems.
cross_object_system.caption_system: No Figure, Fig., Table, Tab., or Algorithm captions occur on pages 1–21; consequently there is no caption title, encoding key, main-finding statement, uncertainty definition, or appendix pointer.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: No table or table header exists. Given/Question blocks, bullet lists, aligned equations, and theorem statements are prose or mathematical displays rather than header/body tables.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: No visual result or ablation object is present. Method, theory results, and boundary claims are linked by section references, numbered propositions/theorems, displayed equations, and appendix proof calls; the five A.2 gadgets are a correctness construction, not a component-deletion ablation.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: The main text calls Appendix A.1–A.7 for proof details, while the appendix supplies equations and invariants only. Neither the main text nor Appendix A contains a Figure/Table, so there is no main–appendix visual pairing.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: No Figure/Table typography can be compared. The rendered document maintains a single-column serif/math and numbered-display hierarchy across the main text, references, and appendix.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: No Figure/Table semantic color system exists. Purple citation/link text and black body/equation text recur as document-level styling and are not visual data encodings.

most_reusable_patterns: For a formula-driven formal theory paper, do not force decorative charts; use numbered equations, Example/Problem blocks, theorem-like statements, and explicit appendix calls to keep the proof chain traceable.
Keep the main text, references, and proof appendix in one-column reading flow and use equation/result numbering instead of a visual-object index.
Move long gadget and translation derivations into a continuous appendix proof while preserving the dependency graph in the main text.
failure_patterns: With no Figure/Table, readers cannot obtain a compact visual overview of the counter, reduction, or succinctness hierarchy; the reconstruction cost is concentrated in prose and dense equations.
Formula density is high on p. 15–20; text extraction or low-resolution screenshots can confuse lettered equation subnumbers with table rows, whereas the native vector PDF remains legible.
There is no visual summary or result table, so complexity, size gaps, and verification consequences must be reconstructed from prose, equations, and theorem statements.
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: The paper uses a single-column, equation- and theorem-driven narrative with no independent Figure/Table, relying on numbering and appendix calls to preserve the formal proof chain.
